ISSUES
Critical:
- The "How It Works" page failed the web performance test. To identify the root cause, investigate server response times, resource loading, and potential bottlenecks.
insights: The pricing page has the lowest Time to First Byte (TTFB) among all pages, suggesting that the server response time is optimal. This could be a result of efficient server-side rendering or caching.

The blog page has the lowest load time (410 ms) and FCP (476 ms), indicating that it is the best-performing page in terms of web performance. Analyze the differences between the blog page and other pages to identify best practices and areas for improvement.

The homepage has a higher load time than the pricing and blog pages, despite having a similar TTFB. This discrepancy suggests that there might be issues with resource loading or rendering, which should be investigated further.
